UI_trait_DanDependentdesc:
Needs a drink every day.
Withdrawal brings stress, pain and the shakes, then seizures for heavy drinkers.
A month sober breaks the habit.
Can be gained by drinking too often.
UI_trait_DanBrittledesc: Hard hits can break an arm, hand or leg.
UI_trait_DanArthritisdesc:
Stiff joints slow movement and swings.
Cold and damp bring painful flares.
Grip can slip mid-swing.
Painkillers and prednisone ease flares.
UI_trait_DanJinxeddesc: Containers sometimes lose an item when first looted.
UI_trait_DanSpiralingdesc:
Depressive episodes hold mood down for days.
Exercise, fresh air and comfort food help.
Antidepressants work after two weeks.
UI_trait_DanBadDaydesc:
Starts naked, drunk, soaked, sick, with an infected cut.
If indoors, the house is on fire.
Disinfectant waits next door.
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicGained: You've come to need a drink
UI_DanTraits_AlcoholicRelapse: One drink was all it took
UI_trait_DanSchizophreniadesc:
Sees and hears things that aren't there.
Sudden bouts of panic.
Worse when stressed, tired or at night.
UI_trait_DanAsthmadesc:
Cold air, corpses, exertion and panic can bring on an attack.
Rest in clean, warm air or use an inhaler.
Starts with an inhaler.
UI_DanTraits_AsthmaBlackout: You come round, wheezing on the floor
UI_DanTraits_DiaBlackout: You come round on the floor, shaking
UI_trait_DanGlutendesc: Wheat brings cramps, nausea and low mood.
UI_trait_DanVegetariandesc:
Refuses meat, fish and insects.
Eggs and dairy are fine.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes1desc:
Needs insulin to bring blood sugar down.
Low or high sugar brings shakes, nausea and harm.
Starts with insulin and a glucose meter.
UI_trait_DanDiabetes2desc:
Blood sugar runs high, worse when overweight.
Exercise, weight loss and metformin help.
Starts with metformin and a glucose meter.
UI_DanTraits_DiaCorrect: To get back to 110: %1 more doses
UI_DanTraits_DiaEat: To get back to 110: eat about %1 g of fast sugar
UI_trait_DanRenFairedesc: Every summer at the faire turns out to have been training.
UI_trait_DanGymRegulardesc: Every exercise starts at half regularity, more in the 20s.
UI_trait_DanCaffeinedesc:
Headache, tiredness and low mood without coffee or tea.
A week without breaks the habit.
UI_trait_DanMigrainedesc:
Hours of pain, nausea and blurred vision.
Triggers differ for everyone.
Sumatriptan or a dark room ends them sooner.
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTriptan: The sumatriptan is taking the edge off
UI_DanTraits_TriptanAfter: Sumatriptan: heavy-limbed and a little clumsy
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_sleep: Your migraines follow a bad night
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_thirst: Your migraines come when you go without water
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_light: Bright light sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_heat: The heat sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_corpses: The stench of the dead sets your migraines off
UI_DanTraits_MigraineTrigger_storm: Your migraines come before a storm
UI_trait_DanHemophiliadesc:
Bleeding never stops on its own.
Loses far more blood. Bandages slow it, stitches stop a deep wound.
UI_trait_DanAnemiadesc:
Tires sooner, recovers slower, catches colds easier.
Needs meat, fish, greens, eggs or iron pills.
UI_trait_DanIronStomachdesc:
Rotten and burnt food do less harm.
Food sickness builds slower.
UI_trait_DanEarlyRiserdesc:
Starts well rested.
Sleep is a little more restful.
UI_trait_DanMealPrepperdesc:
Starts on a good diet.
Diet variety counts over five days.
UI_trait_DanDeepSleeperdesc:
Needs less sleep.
Light rarely wakes you.
UI_DanTraits_GlassesTooDim: Too dim to read without your glasses
UI_DanTraits_BackAche: Your back is starting to ache
UI_DanTraits_BackBad: Your back is killing you. Put something down
UI_DanTraits_KneesBad: Your knees are on fire. Slow down
UI_DanTraits_OldInjuryPart: An old injury: your %1 has never been right
UI_DanTraits_OldInjuryFlare: The weather is in your old injury
UI_trait_DanGreendesc:
Occupation skills start one level lower.
(Does not affect XP gain)
20s only.
UI_trait_DanQuickStudydesc:
Faster XP gain for skills under level 5.
20s only.
UI_trait_DanReadingGlassesdesc:
Reads slower without glasses, and not in dim light.
Starts with reading glasses.
40s and 50s only.
UI_trait_DanBadBackdesc:
Heavy loads build back pain.
40s and 50s only.
UI_trait_DanBadKneesdesc:
Running, climbing and stomping build knee pain.
Walking never rests them; a chair does, a sofa faster.
40s and 50s only.
UI_trait_DanOldHanddesc:
Faster XP gain for the occupation's skills.
40s and 50s only.
UI_trait_DanOldInjurydesc:
One limb is always stiff, worse in cold and damp.
50s only.
UI_trait_DanSetInWaysdesc:
Slower XP gain for skills the occupation doesn't boost, except Fitness and Strength.
50s only.
UI_trait_DanAge20sdesc:
Faster endurance recovery, healing and Fitness and Strength gain.
Faster XP gain for skills under level 3.
Gets hungry faster. Drink, caffeine and meds wear off sooner.
No extra occupation skill levels.
UI_trait_DanBottomlessPitdesc:
Gets hungry faster.
Hunger lowers mood.
20s only.
UI_trait_DanSeenItAlldesc:
Panics less.
Eases Fear of Blood and Germaphobe.
50s only.
UI_trait_DanPaceYourselfdesc:
Swings and sprints cost less endurance.
40s only.
UI_trait_DanSettleddesc:
Sleeps badly away from a bed indoors, or in a new bed.
40s only.
UI_trait_DanOldBonesdesc:
Each morning, warns of bad weather coming tomorrow.
50s only.
UI_trait_DanCastIrondesc:
Fewer medication side effects.
Harder to overdose.
50s only.
UI_trait_DanDelicateStomachdesc:
Junk food, or a drink on an empty stomach, brings nausea.
40s and 50s only.
UI_DanTraits_OldBonesRain: Your bones say rain is coming
UI_DanTraits_OldBonesCold: Your bones say a cold night is coming
UI_trait_DanAge30sdesc: The game as it is: no bonus, no penalty.
UI_DanTraits_PickAgeHint: Pick an age first. The other traits unlock once you have.
UI_trait_DanAge40sdesc:
+2 levels in the occupation's main skill, +1 in its others.
Occupation skills train faster.
Slower endurance recovery, healing and Fitness and Strength gain.
Gets hungry slower. Drink, caffeine and meds last longer.
Health conditions act up more.
UI_trait_DanAge50sdesc:
+3 levels in the occupation's main skill, +2 in its others.
Occupation skills train faster, new skills slower.
Much slower endurance recovery, healing and Fitness and Strength gain.
Gets hungry slower. Drink, caffeine and meds last longer.
Health conditions act up much more.
UI_trait_NightVisionDesc:
Better vision at night.
Light wakes you more easily.
UI_trait_SmokerDesc:
Stress and unhappiness drop after smoking.
Cravings bring irritability and restless sleep.
Slower endurance recovery and a cough.
Three weeks without tobacco breaks the habit.
UI_DanTraits_InfectionLocal: The wound is hot and red
UI_DanTraits_KnoxBeaten: The fever breaks. Somehow, you've beaten it
UI_DanTraits_DressingSpent: The dressing on your %1 needs changing
UI_DanTraits_WoundOpened: The wound on your %1 opened up
UI_DanTraits_BadSet: The bone in your %1 isn't set right
UI_DanTraits_ConcussionLateEnd: The headache from that knock finally lifts
UI_DanTraits_PoorStitches: The stitches in your %1 came out rough
UI_DanTraits_health_StitchesFresh: Stitches fresh, go easy on it
UI_DanTraits_health_ConcussionLate: Headache after a knock to the head
UI_DanTraits_ComeTo: You come round on the floor
UI_DanTraits_BloodComeTo: You come round, cold and shaking
UI_DanTraits_health_KnockToHead: Took a knock to the head
UI_trait_HemophobicDesc:
Panics when bleeding.
Can faint while treating wounds or losing blood.
Cannot give first aid to others.
UI_DanTraits_FaintBlood: You come round, pale and shaking
UI_trait_DanHeartdesc:
Strain builds into chest pain; push through it and your heart gives out.
Beta blockers halve the risk, nitroglycerin ends the pain.
Starts with a bottle of each.
UI_trait_DanEpilepsydesc:
Tiredness, stress, illness and drink can bring on seizures.
Anticonvulsants make them rarer. Starts with a bottle.
UI_trait_DanTinnitusdesc: Gunfire leaves you hard of hearing for a while.
UI_trait_DanLactosedesc: Dairy brings cramps, nausea and low mood.
UI_trait_DanGermaphobedesc:
Stressed and unhappy when dirty or bloody.
Wounds infect slightly less often.
UI_trait_DanSteadyHandsdesc:
Includes Dexterous.
Faster, safer stitching and splinting.
Faster reloading and weapon swaps.
UI_trait_DanFastRecoverydesc:
Includes Fast Healer.
Recovers lost blood faster.
UI_trait_DanThickSkulldesc:
Fewer, milder concussions.
Faster concussion recovery.
Shorter knockouts and faints.
UI_trait_IronGutDesc:
Less chance to have food illness.
Rotten and burnt food do less harm.
UI_trait_resilientdesc:
Less prone to disease.
Slower rate of zombification.
Sometimes survives the Knox infection.
UI_trait_outdoorsmandesc:
Less affected by harsh weather.
Slower to sunburn.
UI_DanTraits_HeartChestPain: A tight, crushing pain in your chest
UI_DanTraits_HeartComeRound: You come round, grey and weak
UI_DanTraits_HeartStronger: Your heart feels a little stronger
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyAura: A strange feeling rising. A seizure is coming
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyComeRound: You come round, confused and aching
UI_DanTraits_HeartBetaLapse: Your beta blockers are wearing off
UI_DanTraits_EpilepsyNight: A seizure in your sleep. You wake aching and worn out
UI_DanTraits_SunblockOff: Your sun block has worn off
UI_trait_DanMSdesc:
Heat brings stiffness, clumsy hands and pain.
Monthly flares bring days of weakness.
Limited energy each day.
Starts with baclofen and amantadine.
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat1: The heat is getting to you
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat2: Too hot. Your hands are going clumsy and sore
UI_DanTraits_MSHeat3: Overheated. Your hands are barely working. Cool down
UI_DanTraits_MSFlare: An MS flare. Your legs are heavy and your hands weak
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_beta: Beta blockers: your stamina is slow to come back today
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_iron: Iron pills: you feel a little sick
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_prednisone: Prednisone: you feel restless and on edge today
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_baclofen: Baclofen: your muscles feel weak today
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_amantadine: Amantadine: you feel a little sick
UI_DanTraits_MedSide_nicotinegum: Nicotine gum: hiccups and a queasy stomach
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_beta: Too many beta blockers: you feel dizzy
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_anticonvulsant: Too many anticonvulsants: you feel heavy and sluggish
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_metformin: Too much metformin: you feel sick
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_diazepam: Too much diazepam: you can barely keep your eyes open
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_prednisone: Too much prednisone: you feel wired and ravenous
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_baclofen: Too much baclofen: your muscles feel like water
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_amantadine: Too much amantadine: you feel jittery and confused
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_inhaler: Too many puffs: your hands shake and your heart races
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_nicotinegum: Too much nicotine gum: you feel sick and dizzy
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_painkillers: Too many painkillers: you feel very sick
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_sumatriptan: Too much sumatriptan: your chest feels tight
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_nitroglycerin: Too much nitroglycerin: the room swims
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_sleepingtablets: Too many sleeping tablets: you can barely stay awake
UI_DanTraits_MedOver_caffeinepills: Too many caffeine pills: you are jittery and your heart pounds
